latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Metacognition skill — a self-reflection engine for AI agents.

- Extracts and reinforces patterns from session transcripts using Hebbian learning and time decay.
- Maintains a categorized knowledge store, building a weighted graph of insights and connections.
- Compiles a token-limited "metacognition lens" summarizing active self-knowledge.
- Provides CLI commands for maintaining, updating, and summarizing insights.
- Supports optional local embeddings for semantic similarity; designed for secure, local use.
